props.title: Approve database migration?
props.children: The agent will add one index and backfill 24,600 records.

controls.name: title
controls.description: Heading of the card header, rendered through Card.Title. With `title`, `description` or `footer` set, children fill the content part.

controls.name: description
controls.description: Secondary text under the title, rendered through Card.Description.

controls.name: footer
controls.description: Footer content: text, elements, component descriptors or arrays of them.

controls.name: variant
controls.description: Surface role: a standard contained surface, an unframed composition (`plain`) or a code canvas (`code`). Default: default.

controls.name: padding
controls.description: Inner surface inset, from the standard 7px rhythm down to flush. Default: default.

controls.name: radius
controls.description: Corner geometry for contained, compact, dialog or flush surfaces. Default: md.

controls.name: border
controls.description: Draw the surface border, independently of padding, radius and variant. Default: true.

controls.name: hoverable
controls.description: Highlight the surface on hover or focus within; does not create an action.

controls.name: fullWidth
controls.description: Stretch to the available inline size; `false` fits the content and keeps the parent's alignment. Default: true.

controls.name: footerAlign
controls.description: Alignment of the `footer` content; compound usage sets `Card.Footer align` instead. Default: end.

controls.name: children
controls.description: Body of the card: the content part beside `title`/`description`/`footer`, or free composition of Card parts.
